name: finance-retriever-bge-small
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Full fine-tune (all 33M params, MultipleNegativesRankingLoss, 6,000 question/context pairs for 2 epochs) of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 on virattt/financial-qa-10K, trained CPU-only on a Ryzen 9 7950X. Same tensor set and config as the base. The card prints a four-metric base-vs-finetuned table on a held-out SEC 10-K retrieval set (300 queries, ~4,000 passages) and states the limitation itself: 'not a BeIR-wide benchmark'. Treat these as in-domain gains: +15pp Recall@1 on financial filings says nothing about general retrieval, and a 33M model fine-tuned on 6k pairs is a classic place to see domain overfit. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-04.
